newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA'S WAY BERZINSH BECOMES RIGA MAYOR.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA'S WAY BERZINSH BECOMES RIGA MAYOR.

text.p: Riga city got a new mayor on Tuesday as leading Latvia's Way member Andris Berzinsh was voted into the post.
He gained 32 votes compared to the 31 needed for a majority after fierce arguments between the leading political parties over who should get the post.

"Riga has to again become the economic centre of the Baltics, with capital flows concentrating here and entering the region, making use of Riga's favourable geographic position," Berzinsh told journalists.
He said that the political parties in the council should copy the way of cooperating chosen by the government parties, which rule according to a coalition agreement.
Riga mayor is also head of Riga harbour board.
Berzinsh said he thought that the port has unused potential, especially in dry cargos and fuel transit.
Infrastructure has to be improved, deepening the port waters where necessary and serious companies have to be attracted.
"Riga harbour has to become a bigger bread-winner for Riga than it is at the moment," he added.

Berzinsh is a former welfare mininister in a previous government, led by current foreign minister, Valdis Birkavs. Berzinsh was also state minister of employment in the ministry of welfare under the first government of current prime minister, Andris Shkele.
